description.en:
A series of train excursions with the "unfortunate sister" that show off the power of an adult in vain. There are many different types of train lovers, such as "train riders" and "train takers," but she is a "traveling railroader" in her own right.

(google translated)
description.ja: 「残念なお姉さん」と共に巡るオトナ力無駄に発揮な鉄道小旅行の数々。「乗り鉄」「撮り鉄」等、鉄道好きも様々ですが彼女は素直に「旅鉄」です。
